ECOSYSTEM FOUNDATION

Device-specific drivers, shared platform

MechKeyMesh is structured as a multi-vendor platform. The AULA F108 Pro is the first complete implementation and validation target. Future keyboards add independent drivers and data-driven layouts instead of keyboard-specific UI code.
